note: Easy-v2 menu plus pose actions. Default experiments keep ee_pg_easy_v2_lib.json or ee_pg_lib_frozen.json. Enable by passing this file, or set POSE_MENU=1 to inject the same intents into another library. Ablate with POSE_MENU_KINDS=rotate or align or home. Align clearances small/medium/large are 0.05/0.08/0.15 m. In-place yaw holds position. Side approaches keep the current height and face the gripper toward the object. Targets use the one-shot Astra grasp point, object top centre, and object height. Generic cold-start pick-and-place menu over honest LIBERO signals (proprioception, finger contact flags, Astra keypoints). No task-specific constants. + multi-action stall feedback (raise/redescend, lateral recenter, relative yaw, confirm contact, clear/reapproach, push_aside) via stall_feedback recoveries; neighbour-block prefers clear then open-finger push_aside along gripper open axis / away from grasp; descent_servo_stalled fires on servo stall/timeout after descend without dist(tcp,grasp) gate; descent_stalled keeps near-grasp contactless variant. + hybrid ask_astra/consult_astra (Jev-chosen Astra help; hard stall/identity force; shared MAX_SLOW). + episode-start Great Wall plan prior (predict neighbour block → push_aside/clear before first approach). + place-phase: consecutive lower_to_place stall / lift↔lower thrash over place → force open_gripper (place_force_release).
intent_instructions: Select the next intent whose definition and preconditions match observed_facts and the predicates. Typical order: move_above_object, descend_to_grasp, close_gripper, lift, carry_to_place, lower_to_place, open_gripper, retreat, finish. If descent_servo_stalled, descent_stalled, descent_hit, or empty_close is true, prefer move_above_object / reopen_and_retry after recovery feedback — do not keep selecting close_gripper without bilateral contact. When a neighbour blocks the grasp angle, recovery may clear then push_aside the blocker (geometry-based; no fixed yaw) before re-approaching. For tall bottles/containers after a tip or near miss: keep clearance above the body, center, then descend vertically (tip/push aside neighbours if too close — no fixed scene angles). When stuck, identity unsure, or descent stalled/empty close, you may select ask_astra (or consult_astra) to request Astra help — not every step; it shares the slow-think budget. If lower_to_place repeatedly stalls/timeouts while above_place, prefer open_gripper (release) over more lift↔lower thrash. Pose menu: you may rotate the gripper in place by 15 or 45 degrees, or by 15 degrees toward the estimated grasp yaw; or align to the top, left, right, front, or back of the target at a small, medium, or large clearance; or return to the home pose. In-place rotation holds position. Side alignments keep the current height and turn the gripper toward the object. Read pose_action_outcome before repeating one.

intents.name: move_above_object
intents.definition: Gripper open and not above_grasp: move above the estimated grasp point.

intents.name: descend_to_grasp
intents.definition: above_grasp is true and at_grasp is false, gripper open: descend to the grasp point.

intents.name: close_gripper
intents.definition: at_grasp is true and the gripper is open: close the fingers.

intents.name: lift
intents.definition: Gripper closed on the object and not lifted: raise vertically.

intents.name: carry_to_place
intents.definition: lifted is true and above_place is false: carry the held object above the place point.
intents.refpoint: vec(place[0] + grasp[0] - objc[0], place[1] + grasp[1] - objc[1], tcp[2])

intents.name: lower_to_place
intents.definition: above_place is true and the gripper is still closed: lower the object to the release height.
intents.refpoint: vec(tcp[0], tcp[1], place[2] + clear + tcp_at_close[2] - objc[2] + obj_h)

intents.name: open_gripper
intents.definition: The object has been lowered over the place point: open the fingers to release.

intents.name: retreat
intents.definition: released_since_close is true: raise the empty gripper.

intents.name: reopen_and_retry
intents.definition: The grasp failed (gripper closed but the object is not held): open and go back above the grasp point.

intents.name: relook
intents.definition: Ask the camera perception module to look again and refresh object/place estimates and whether the object is held.

intents.name: ask_astra
intents.definition: Request Astra slow-think help when stuck, identity unsure, approach looks wrong, or experience_brief suggests consulting vision. Not every step — budget-limited; prefer after stall/timeout/empty close/identity doubt over blind close_gripper.

intents.name: consult_astra
intents.definition: Alias of ask_astra: consult Astra for an episode-only diagnosis and recovery plan (shares the slow-think budget).

intents.name: rotate_yaw_plus_15
intents.definition: Hold position and rotate gripper yaw by 15 degrees positive about vertical.

intents.name: rotate_yaw_minus_15
intents.definition: Hold position and rotate gripper yaw by 15 degrees negative about vertical.

intents.name: rotate_yaw_plus_45
intents.definition: Hold position and rotate gripper yaw by 45 degrees positive about vertical.

intents.name: rotate_yaw_minus_45
intents.definition: Hold position and rotate gripper yaw by 45 degrees negative about vertical.

intents.name: rotate_yaw_toward_astra
intents.definition: Hold position and rotate gripper yaw by 15 degrees toward the estimated grasp yaw.

intents.name: align_top_small
intents.definition: Move to the top of the target object at small clearance, using the grasp point, object top centre, and object height estimates.

intents.name: align_top_medium
intents.definition: Move to the top of the target object at medium clearance, using the grasp point, object top centre, and object height estimates.

intents.name: return_home
intents.definition: Return to the initial end-effector pose for recovery. Finger command stays as it is.

intents.name: finish
intents.definition: The object was released at the place and the gripper retreated: stop.

predicates.name: above_grasp
predicates.expr: dist_xy(tcp, grasp) < 0.3*obj_h and tcp[2] > grasp[2] + obj_h
predicates.meaning: gripper is roughly above the grasp point

predicates.name: at_grasp
predicates.meaning: gripper is at the grasp point

predicates.name: lifted
predicates.meaning: closed gripper is raised well above grasp and place heights

predicates.name: above_place
predicates.expr: dist_xy(vec(tcp[0] - grasp[0] + objc[0], tcp[1] - grasp[1] + objc[1], 0), place) < 0.3*obj_h
predicates.meaning: held object is roughly above the place point

predicates.name: at_grasp_relaxed
predicates.expr: contact or (prev == 'descend_to_grasp' and n_same >= 2 and dist(tcp, grasp) < 0.6*obj_h and (left_contact or right_contact) and (n_close == 0 or opening_at_close >= 0.15*open_max))
predicates.meaning: Both fingers touch, or descent repeated near grasp with at least one finger contact (not a contactless stall).

predicates.name: empty_close
predicates.expr: closed_cmd and n_close >= 1 and opening_at_close < 0.15*open_max and not contact

predicates.name: descent_hit
predicates.expr: prev == 'descend_to_grasp' and not closed_cmd and (left_contact or right_contact) and not contact
predicates.meaning: one finger hit something while descending with open fingers

predicates.name: descent_servo_stalled
predicates.expr: prev == 'descend_to_grasp' and not closed_cmd and not contact and (last_result == 'stalled' or last_result == 'timeout')
predicates.meaning: open-finger descend reported servo stalled or timeout — fires even when grasp estimate is far (no dist gate)
predicates.evidence: P0: dist(tcp,grasp) gate hid real stalls when Astra grasp was off / neighbour block

predicates.name: descent_stalled
predicates.expr: prev == 'descend_to_grasp' and not closed_cmd and not contact and dist(tcp, grasp) < 1.5*obj_h and (n_same >= 2 or last_result == 'stalled' or last_result == 'timeout')
predicates.meaning: open-finger descent stalled or repeated near the grasp estimate without bilateral contact
predicates.evidence: near-grasp contactless variant; sibling of descent_servo_stalled (no dist gate)

recoveries.trigger: closed_cmd and above_place and place_lower_stall_n >= 3 and (prev == 'lower_to_place' or place_lift_lower_cycles >= 2)
recoveries.evidence: carry reached + lower_to_place thrash (stall/timeout) over place XY → force release instead of endless lift↔lower (harness also hard-gates via MAX_PLACE_LOWER_STALL)

recoveries.trigger: (descent_hit or descent_servo_stalled or descent_stalled) and clear_reapproach_n >= 1 and not closed_cmd and not contact
recoveries.evidence: unilateral/neighbour block after clear_reapproach without progress → open-finger push_aside then re-approach (geometry; no object names / fixed yaw)
unilateral contact on descent → clear/reapproach menu (not relook-only)
empty close → raise/recenter feedback rather than relook-only
servo stall after descend OR near-grasp contactless stall → multi-action stall feedback

recoveries.trigger: at_grasp_relaxed and contact and not closed_cmd and not at_grasp and prev == 'descend_to_grasp'
recoveries.evidence: only close when bilateral contact present — contactless stall uses stall_feedback

recoveries.trigger: prev == 'descend_to_grasp' and n_same >= 2 and not closed_cmd and not left_contact and not right_contact and not at_grasp and not descent_stalled and not descent_servo_stalled
evidence: excludes both descent_stalled and descent_servo_stalled to avoid dead zones / double-fire

lessons.name: contact during descent
lessons.signature: a finger touches something before the close while descending
lessons.instead: stop descending and look again; the object was probably pushed or is blocked

lessons.name: empty close
lessons.signature: fingers close almost fully without contact
lessons.instead: the object probably moved; look again before regrasping

lessons.name: blocked target
lessons.signature: the target object is occluded or hemmed in by neighbours
lessons.instead: clear the path by pushing the blocker aside, or change the approach direction

lessons.name: high release
lessons.signature: the object is released far above the place surface
lessons.instead: lower the object close to the place surface before opening

lessons.name: stalled descent is not grasp confirmation
lessons.signature: Descent stalls near the estimated grasp point without finger contact, and subsequent closes leave the fingers nearly shut while the object stays on its support.
lessons.instead: Treat the close as empty and reassess alignment and reachable grasp geometry; proximity or a reached descent target does not establish capture, and repeated approach cycles after a missed close do not demonstrate progress.

lessons.name: wrong object grasped
lessons.signature: the language names a specific object, a similar neighbour is nearby, and after contact or lift the goal object is still on the table while something else is held
lessons.instead: discard the current grasp estimate and look again for the language-goal object before regrasping

lessons.name: near approach tips tall object
lessons.signature: approaching or descending too close to a tall bottle or can tips or pushes it before the grasp closes
lessons.instead: keep a clear height above the body, center over it, then descend vertically

lessons.name: preserve identity across approach updates
lessons.signature: Earlier informative views distinguish the target or expose a candidate mismatch, but later approach views obscure identity and refreshed estimates continue directing the gripper toward a neighbouring item.
lessons.instead: Reconcile the candidate with earlier visual evidence before accepting refreshed grasp estimates. Later occlusion does not erase an earlier visible identity mismatch, and approaching a wrong candidate does not establish that it was grasped or carried. Preserving identity across updates remains a proposed recovery rather than a demonstrated successful intervention.

lessons.name: place target may be wrong
lessons.signature: after a successful lift the place region may still refer to the wrong container or surface for the language goal
lessons.instead: verify the place region against the language goal before carrying and releasing

lessons.name: contact without held
lessons.signature: Both fingers report contact after closing while the last camera estimate says the object is not held.
lessons.instead: Treat the camera estimate as potentially stale rather than reopening solely on that estimate; sustained bilateral contact and an opening consistent with the object support attempting a lift, while ambiguous current evidence warrants refreshed perception.

lessons.name: do not push the goal
lessons.signature: a push-aside clears a blocker near the target
lessons.instead: push only the blocker; never push the language-goal object

lessons.name: wait for official success
lessons.signature: The object has been released over the target and official success has not yet been reported.
lessons.instead: Allow release and retreat to complete without immediately regrasping; distinguish an issued finish from confirmed success and judge the outcome using the official check.

lessons.name: refresh approach after contactless descent stalls
lessons.signature: Open finger descent stalls without finger contact while the object remains on its support, sometimes followed by repeated approach and descent cycles.
lessons.instead: Refresh alignment within the perception budget and reassess approach clearance; refreshes and a shallower grasp can still end in an empty close and continued oscillation, so neither establishes a reliable recovery or justifies a universal pose override.

lessons.name: distinguish refused closure from empty capture
lessons.signature: Repeated close selections are refused by identity checks while the fingers remain open without contact; the arm stays near the candidate or repeats approach and descent without lifting or carrying.
lessons.instead: Classify the refused actions as blocked execution. Repeated approach cycles and close selections after the perception budget is exhausted do not resolve identity refusal. Check earlier informative views before accepting an occluded candidate; obtaining a clearer view remains an untested recovery. These observations do not establish empty capture or justify changing grasp depth or orientation.

lessons.name: predict neighbour block before approach
lessons.signature: at episode start a neighbouring object sits close to the language-goal grasp so the open gripper path may collide before a bilateral close
lessons.instead: plan a push_aside or clear_reapproach of the blocker before the first approach and grasp; do not wait until stall contact during descent
